phases.name: Foundation
gaps: Legacy DELETE routes (task, project, workspace, label, column, canned response, comment/activity, milestone, prerequisite, role, invitation) bypass pending actions; legacy task delete is a hard delete with S3 removal
MCP package exposes direct destructive tools (delete_task, delete_task_comment, delete_label, delete_task_relation) with no human approval
In-memory fire-and-forget event bus (events/index.ts publishEvent) still drives legacy mutations and notification/plugin subscribers, violating the transactional-outbox rule
Elevated deletes (workspace, project, API key, webhook, identity connection) do not create elevated pending actions; project delete is not session-only
No Idempotency-Key middleware and no requester notification for API-key deletion requests
No pending-action 'failed' execution outcome; no service-key/no_approver handling
No automation runtime: EV-3 depth/self-origin guards and mcp_destructive/decide_approval flows unimplemented
No parent outbox consumer, no digest writer, no audit-purge job, no POST /api/instance/purge
actions: Route DELETE /api/project/{id} and DELETE /api/workspace/{workspaceId} through createPendingAction (elevated, session-only, typed-name confirmation) and add sessionOnly:true to project/policy.ts; add integration tests mirroring pending-action-comment-deletion.test.ts

Convert legacy DELETE /api/task/{id} to soft delete via the work-item deletion pending action (or 410 it behind the existing Sunset header) and remove direct S3 deletion from task/controllers/delete-task.ts
Remove or rewire packages/mcp delete_* tools to the canonical 202 routes and return pendingActionId for polling; add MCP unit tests
Wrap label, column, canned-response, milestone, prerequisite, document-link, time-entry and workspace-role deletes in pending actions using the generic click-deletion-executor.ts pattern
Add a 'failed' terminal path in approval executors (catch execution error, mark failed, emit pending_action.executed{outcome:failed}, audit) with a fault-injection test
Add Idempotency-Key middleware for 202 delete requests and a pending_action.requested notification resolver for api-key/mcp origins via enqueueNotificationEvent
Add integration tests asserting replay of fan-out hits notification_event_person_unique / notification_delivery_event_recipient_channel_unique without duplicate rows
Migrate legacy publishEvent callers to recordWorkItemEvent/enqueueOutboxEvent inside their transactions, keeping the in-memory bus for websocket hints only
